article.story: NORMAN, Okla. -- — Brooklyn Stewart scored 21 points, Aaliyah Chavez added 19 and No. 14 Oklahoma had three others finish with double-doubles in a 124-48 rout over Texas Southern on Tuesday night. Sahara Williams added 14 points to go with 10 assists for Oklahoma (5-0). Sa’Myah Smith scored 14 points and LeeLee Bell chipped in with 13 points, and they each grabbed 10 rebounds. Oklahoma had all 12 players score, with eight finishing in double figures. The Sooners jumped out to a 36-4 lead in the first quarter, outscored the Tigers 31-7 in the second and led 67-11 at the break. Chavez scored 13 points in the first half and Smith added 12. The Sooners shot 64% (27 of 42) from the field in the first half and held Texas Southern to 3 of 21 from the floor and 1 of 10 from long range. The Tigers' starters didn't take a foul shot in the first half and were 0 of 9 from the floor. DeAvion Wilson led Texas Southern (0-5) with 12 points. She converted a three-point play for the Tigers’ 12th point of the third quarter. Oklahoma held San Jose State to five points in the third quarter on Nov. 10. The Sooners have never held an opponent to single digits for all four quarters. The Sooners have scored at least 90 points and have won by double digits in each of their five games, including a 91-79 season-opening win in Paris over then-No. 12 North Carolina. Up next Texas Southern: at UTEP on Saturday.
